bounded_authority: Specification for root staging only. No shared renderer/checker/schema/site/tracker/Git/deployment/release mutation was performed.

field_mapping.title: Exact published title in h1, HTML title, citation_title and ScholarlyArticle headline.
field_mapping.description: Unique meta description, Open Graph description and structured-data description.
field_mapping.abstract: Full original abstract, all words/sentences/qualifications retained under the stated typography normalization; indexable HTML and ScholarlyArticle.abstract.
field_mapping.abstract_heading: Display Original abstract. The current shared renderer hardcodes Abstract and ignores this field; root must make a bounded per-page adaptation and inspect actual output without altering abstract text.
field_mapping.result: The precise result: actual initial discrete additive G, inherited order/addition, H=T[G] contained in Oz and initial in AMBIENT No; sets/proper classes in NBG/global choice and zero.
field_mapping.why_it_works: Keep exact ordered-block sign rotation, nonbottom right-prefix reflection, bottom normalization, actual supports and PUBLISHED appendix sufficiency; credit standard cut/normal-form imports.
field_mapping.limitations: Retain full mathematical boundaries, prior credit, bounded priority/novelty/current-openness limits and supplementary-only computation status.
field_mapping.ai_disclosure: Extensive AI assistance; unrefereed; no independent human/journal peer review or formal proof-assistant certification. Author responsibility.
field_mapping.edition_note: The manuscript and Zenodo’s declared publication date are 17 October 2026. Version 1.0.0 is the Zenodo metadata label; the manuscript prints the date without a version number. Zenodo created the record on 18 October 2026 UTC. These edition dates do not establish historical priority.
field_mapping.background: Linked credited primary work. No new exhaustive priority, firstness or current-global-open assertion.
field_mapping.collaboration: Passive general invitation, actual substantive research/writing contributions and mutual agreement; no prepared outreach to individuals.
field_mapping.canonical_url: Use final slug-derived canonical in canonical tag, Open Graph, ScholarlyArticle, citation_pdf_url, research index/ItemList and sitemap at actual staging.
field_mapping.source_binding: Private provenance only; never publish hashes, report/receipt paths, counts, internal timestamps or control narratives.
field_mapping.review_metadata: Private preparation state only, excluded from public copy and public structured data.

custom_verdict_requirements.root_authority: promotion.status is copied from the exact later root scientific clearance (8f9acb77adf26af8699a42bfdc1f706e2c77978ae722083f8be50d63f8e89aa1); this is not a rendering/live/browser/native-publication PASS.
custom_verdict_requirements.scope_original: Preserve the entire original verdict, including status=SCOPE_COMPLETE_PENDING_MATHEMATICAL_REVIEW, mathematical_pass=null, root_publication_clearance=false and candidate_only=true. Its frozen candidate retains candidate_only=true and the pending candidate_gate.
custom_verdict_requirements.analytic_original: Preserve complete original status=PASS, exact_remaining_mathematical_gap and all limitations. Do not reduce the original object to its status.
custom_verdict_requirements.adversarial_original: Preserve complete original status=PASS, mathematical_verdict=PASS, remaining_gap=null and publication_authorized_by_this_agent=false.
custom_verdict_requirements.chronology: Complete original custom verdict objects are embedded unchanged in promotion.json. Later root_disposition and scope_gate_resolution are separate authority fields, never retroactive edits of the scope worker or candidate.

receipt_requirements.identity: The entire original receipt object and each full file-entry object are preserved in promotion.json; frozen receipt and paths remain unchanged.
receipt_requirements.record_shape: This receipt has record_sha256 of sources/record.json. Keep it unchanged; no synthetic raw-record field is added.
receipt_requirements.asset_shape: Original file entries use name/url/bytes/md5/sha256/zenodo_checksum; all extra original fields remain preserved.

asset_specification.pdf: Copy initial-omnific-models.pdf from sources unchanged. Use that same local asset for iframe, direct-open and explicit local download with download attribute; retain Zenodo original PDF link. Never regenerate the PDF.
asset_specification.supplement: Copy the complete initial-omnific-models-source-and-verification.zip unchanged, with local download and Zenodo original ZIP links. Do not extract, trim or repack the public supplement.
asset_specification.reader_identity: The one embedded PDF equals the standalone 7-page reader. There is one distinct reader and no nested archive.
asset_specification.download_adapter: The current shared renderer does not provide this page an explicit local PDF download attribute. Root must carry public-sections links/iframe through to actual HTML and check them.
asset_specification.no_extra_assets: No public third-party source cache, additional reader, framework or visual asset is needed.

metadata_specification.author: Alec Kriebel
metadata_specification.scholarly_graph: Exact title, author/ORCID, edition date/version, DOI, full original abstract, freely accessible PDF encoding and unrefereed status. Private review metadata is excluded.
metadata_specification.citation: citation_title, citation_author, citation_author_orcid, citation_publication_date=2026/10/17, citation_doi and canonical-local citation_pdf_url. Proposed citation.bib identifies edition and AI/unrefereed status.
metadata_specification.discovery: One final canonical entry in /research/, ItemList and sitemap when staged; verify indexable prose and link consistency.

layout: Use the established plain white personal-blog layout, Arial typography, readable single column, ordinary links and headings. No new framework.
remaining_root_gates: Read the full REPORT, PUBLIC_COPY, public-sections, publication/promotion configs, adapter and seal before staging.
Verify actual rendered copy, full abstract, metadata and local asset identity.
Complete live HTTP/byte checks and desktop/mobile browser inspection.
Populate native Sheet AA canonical URL only after verified live.
